integrity: The proof parameterizes every affine minorant of the scalar quadratic, shows tangent domination at fixed slope, derives the exact global descent-slowness envelope, and treats the exact-gap nonattainment separately. The bundled exact-arithmetic replay is supporting verification rather than a substitute for the quantified proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-dimensional unconstrained geometry for the affine W-certificate on a strongly convex quadratic. It does not characterize bundle-generated minorants, constrained quadratics, multidimensional anisotropic problems, or the full BLW/A-BLW iteration.
title: Exact modulus-inflation frontier for affine W-certificates on a scalar quadratic
